name: Ferritin
overview: Ferritin is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include ferritin is a universal intracellular and extracellular protein that stores iron and releases it in a controlled fashion; the protein is produced by almost all living organisms, including archaea, bacteria, algae, higher plants, and animals; it is the primary intracellular iron-storage protein in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes, keeping iron in a soluble and non-toxic form. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
purpose: In routine practice, ferritin is a universal intracellular and extracellular protein that stores iron and releases it in a controlled fashion.
Health professionals note that the protein is produced by almost all living organisms, including archaea, bacteria, algae, higher plants, and animals.
Health professionals note that it is the primary intracellular iron-storage protein in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes, keeping iron in a soluble and non-toxic form.
From a clinical perspective, in humans, it acts as a buffer against iron deficiency and iron overload.
